profile_text.body:
Figma is a public company (ticker: FIG, CIK: 0001579878) that offers a collaborative design platform. The company describes itself as "the canvas where design, code, and AI come together," positioning its product as a single shared workspace where teams can move from initial concept to shipped product. According to its site, both human teammates and AI agents operate in the same space with shared context, supporting tasks such as generating new design directions, refining work, and aligning across a team.

Figma's tracked AI product is Figma AI, categorized under image and graphic design. It encompasses auto-layout, content generation, and design system governance capabilities, all surfaced within the core Figma canvas. The product is noted in connection with a prior Adobe acquisition context, though no further detail on that matter appears in the available data.

The held facts confirm Figma is a for-profit public company with no recorded litigation or MCP server presence in this dataset.
